title: Sturdy, but finish was somewhat lacking
text: Sturdy, but finish was somewhat lacking. It is definitely sturdy, but noticed a slight ‘defect’ in how the cane was binded.  Thankfully, it is nearer the top of the basket, And shouldn’t affect the esthetic of the top of the sourdough.  I always wash any new Banneton before first use, thereafter, you use a toothbrush to clear any flour.  I wouldn’t necessarily buy from this supplier again,,but at the price point, it is modestly cheaper aNd still give you the support for final proof.
